scope: DAY_3_OBJECTIVE_A -- reproducibility-gap investigation; no Provider calls, no Fresh Runs

run_provenance.note: All 43 row-level failure samples share this single run_id (the 200-row blind holdout5 sample).

key_finding.summary: Both LLM-facing prompts responsible for the actual historical decisions in these 21 samples (alpha_classifier for Category A/C, evidence_stance_classifier for Category B) were substantially rewritten in this single commit, 28 days after the holdout5 run that produced the reviewed claims. Both rewrites are directly on-topic for the exact failure patterns found (ambiguous-Alpha deferral / shallow keyword matching for A/C; single-clause, hedge-blind stance resolution for B). This is verified via git diff and persisted old/new prompt text (both quoted in full per-row below), not inferred or assumed.

verification_limits: Per Day 3's no-Provider-calls rule, none of the 21 cases' actual responsible LLM-backed decision was re-invoked today. Day 2's direct re-run of the separate, always-shadow, never-authoritative deterministic evidence_stance.py classifier (for Category B only) also failed to reproduce the historical output, which is consistent with but does not itself prove the prompt-change explanation. No case here is labeled CURRENTLY_CORRECT or FIXED -- all 21 are FIX_PROVENANCE_IDENTIFIED pending a Day 4 frozen-input recomputation against current code, which alone can confirm the corrected behavior. This is a deliberate, conservative distinction, not an oversight.
